title: Mechanism Design for Ad-Supported Platforms
abstract: arXiv:2609.12870v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many digital platforms earn revenue by selling content access and displaying ads. We study monopoly screening by a platform allocating heterogeneous content and ads to heterogeneous consumers. Advertising generates revenue and affects information rents through nuisance, which alters the platform's incentives to allocate content. The optimal mechanism balances a trade-off between advertising and rent extraction: Expanding content access increases advertising revenue but reduces sales revenue by raising information rents. The mechanism features novel distortions in content access and ad exposure, rationalizes contracts across ad-supported platforms, and explains why greater ad profitability may weaken incentives to invest in content quality.

translated_title: 广告支持型平台的机制设计
translated_abstract: 许多数字平台通过出售内容访问权和展示广告来获得收入。我们研究了平台向异质性消费者分配异质性内容与广告的垄断筛选问题。广告既能产生收入，又会通过滋扰效应影响信息租金，从而改变平台分配内容的激励。最优机制在广告收入与租金提取之间进行权衡：扩大内容访问范围会增加广告收入，但会通过提高信息租金而减少销售收入。该机制在内容访问和广告曝光方面呈现出新颖的扭曲，为各类广告支持型平台的合约提供了合理解释，并解释了为什么更高的广告盈利能力可能会削弱平台投资于内容质量的激励。
tldr: 本文研究了广告支持型平台的最优机制设计，揭示了广告收入与信息租金提取之间的权衡关系，并由此解释了内容访问与广告曝光的新颖扭曲现象，以及更高的广告盈利能力为何可能削弱平台对内容质量的投资激励。
en_tdlr: This paper studies optimal mechanism design for ad-supported platforms, revealing a fundamental trade-off between advertising revenue and information rent extraction, and explains novel distortions in content access and ad exposure, as well as why greater ad profitability may weaken incentives to invest in content quality.
